admin.title: Points settings
admin.intro: Change values whenever you like — a change applies only to what is earned afterward, and never rewrites anyone's past balance.

catalogue.heading: The points catalogue
catalogue.fixedNote: The actions are fixed: you change their values, never add one. Reservations and reactions earn nothing and cannot be set to.

manual.heading: Manual adjustment
manual.intro: Add points to a member or deduct them, with a reason that appears in their history and in the audit log. The entry cannot be deleted: to correct a mistake, record the opposite adjustment.

manual.amountHint: From one to a hundred thousand.
manual.reasonHint: Members see it in their points history.
